samples.title: dataset25 sentinel (minimal)
samples.description: 290 strokes (95 inside, 195 outside) on all 36 views: 177 at the start and 113 more between iterations 152 and 1099. Recorded with RGB photos input, smoothing 0.398 and re-init every 5 / step 0.5, at grid 300. Plug in adds it to the current run; Play re-initialises with those settings and replays it.
